source_notes: Silver diethyldithiocarbamate stock is prepared at 0.1 mol scale, whereas the QD reactor is charged with 0.1 mmol; these are not interchangeable quantities.
The 10 nm AgNO3 branch explicitly inherits the 5.4 nm route except for silver source.
The DHLA exchange input is 'as-prepared Ag2S sample' with no physical aliquot ID; the Results discuss a 5.4 nm DT/DHLA comparison.
Figure 1/2 crops include printed captions; ACS permission status remains unverified.
